_what: Production routes a variation's recipe may name, with the rate the machine multiplies. The recipe stage (5) names a route id and the units; the machine does the arithmetic from this file, so a price change is one edit here and never a prompt edit. Rates are research facts from the Model Map v1 (27 Sep 2026) and the locked choices, which follow components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20) (GPT Image direct via OpenAI for every picture and edit; Omni on fal, Seedance and MiniMax on Higgsfield for clips; Genjutsu for swipe shots; editing jobs on the local studio).

routes.name: Seedance 2.5 on Higgsfield, 720p
routes.note: 28 credits per 4 s; +30% overshoot allowed for re-rolls. Strongest motion; goes cinematic — components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20).

routes.name: Omni (Gemini Omni Flash 1.1) on fal, 720p
routes.note: Talking heads, consistent faces, phone-look movement; the machine's clip default. 360p $0.03/s, 1080p $0.15/s. The approved read is fitted to the lips — components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20).

routes.name: MiniMax H3 on Higgsfield, 2K
routes.note: Cheap B-roll with nobody talking ONLY (2 credits a second). Never talking — components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20).

routes.name: Genjutsu object swap on Higgsfield, 1080p
routes.note: Our cast or product into the swipe's own shot, its motion kept; 35 credits per ~4 s. When it keeps the original face, use genjutsu-hf (motion transfer) — components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20).

routes.name: Genjutsu motion transfer on Higgsfield, 1080p
routes.note: 44 credits per ~4 s clip as charged. 24 fps output → de-dup + interpolate.

routes.name: Wan 2.2 Animate Replace on fal, 720p
routes.note: DEPRECATED 2026-10-20 — Wan is not in the Generative Model House (components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20)). TEST — cheaper motion-transfer candidate. $0.08 per billed second, billed = frames ÷ 16 → ≈$0.12 per real second at 23.976 fps. Keeps the video's own background, relit.

routes.name: Kling 3.0 Motion Control on fal, 720p
routes.note: DEPRECATED 2026-10-20 — Kling is not in the Generative Model House; Genjutsu motion transfer does this job (components/generative-model-house/MODEL-HOUSE.md (the Generative Model House, 2026-10-20)). TEST — cheaper motion-transfer candidate.
